claimed_surface: Bounded v0.33 independent static-validity typing, labels, collation, expression-child scopes and CTE environments, recursive reference guards, and query type finalization. Runtime evaluation, cardinality, literal conversion, documented unsupported features and release approval are outside this review.

attempts.description: Independently authored scalar/IN expressions over unknown strings, NULL, text/name/varchar/char, integers, Boolean and arrays; explicit C/POSIX identities; scalar child casts, ordering and limits; unknown set operands; nested WITH scopes in recursive SubLinks. Compared frozen CLI contract classifications to isolated PostgreSQL 16 PREPARE.
attempts.actual: 309 valid/native-success, 215 invalid/native-error, 72 syntax rejection/native-error, two unsupported/native-success, and 12 valid/native-error due exclusively to excluded malformed literal conversion. No invalid/native-success case.

attempts.description: Used psql gdesc without executing each valid/native-success query from the first population. Compared output labels and concrete types/modifiers.
attempts.actual: Labels and types matched, including scalar label inheritance, name and name[] outputs, varchar(3), char(3), unknown-set type finalization and smallint.

attempts.description: Recursive references through nested WITH/derived FROM; nested independent recursive CTE shadowing; forbidden self references in IN children, LIMIT and OFFSET; permitted locally shadowed child references; numeric/varchar modifiers and set-operation collation compositions.
attempts.actual: 71 valid/native PREPARE-success and 30 invalid/native-error. Native descriptors matched the 71 accepted cases, including numeric(3,1) versus merged numeric and cast varchar(7). Optional execution observations contained excluded scalar cardinality and noncollatable pg_collation_for errors; these were not treated as static defects.

attempts.description: Bounded authored scalar children with UNION/UNION ALL and LIMIT 1; combinations of text/name/varchar and explicit C/POSIX; scalar casts and CASE inheritance, plus name[] collations. Compared pg_collation_for observations to frozen CLI outputCollations.
attempts.actual: 61 successful observations and 61 matching identities. Conflicting explicit identities were rejected before observation.

attempts.description: Inspected independent expression typing/labels/collation rules and proof-producing child checker, exact inherited CTE environment versus local row scope, unknown set-input finalization, and structural recursive guards.

conclusion: No concrete static-validity discrepancy was found in these bounded constructed attempts. This is not release or full PostgreSQL approval.
workspace_changes: No frozen-source, live-repository, Lake, olean or CLI writes. Review scripts and evidence were written only under /tmp. Python bytecode writing was disabled; isolated native clusters were stopped and removed.
